name: crypto
title: Crypto
description: A live crypto price card for json-render chats: price, change, market cap, volume and a trend line with a 24H/1W/1M/1Y/All switch, with its API route and a rate-limit-safe cache in front of CoinGecko and Kraken.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   CryptoCard: cryptoCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: CryptoCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LiveCryptoCard symbol={props.symbol || undefined} range={props.range ?? "24h"} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     CryptoCard: cryptoLookup

Prices load from /api/crypto (installed at app/api/crypto/route.ts), backed by CoinGecko's public API, and Kraken's for the All range. No API key needed; the route caches each coin for a minute to stay inside CoinGecko's free rate limit.
